empty.title: No spec files yet
empty.body: Drop your PRDs, tech specs, and acceptance criteria under .devdigest/specs/. Every agent and the PR brief read them as grounding context.

page.documentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No documents} one {# document} other {# documents}} discovered in the clone
page.omitted: {count, plural, one {# more document beyond the discovery cap} other {# more documents beyond the discovery cap}}
page.loadError: Couldn’t load this repository’s project context.

notCloned.title: {repo} isn’t cloned yet
notCloned.body: Project documents are read from the repository clone on its default branch. Clone or refresh {repo}, then resync.

noDocuments.title: No project documents found
noDocuments.body: Nothing matched under {roots}. Add markdown (.md or .mdx) under one of those four roots and resync.

preview.placeholderBody: Pick a document from the list to preview it here.
preview.truncated: This document is large — the preview shows only its first part.
preview.reasonNotFound: The file is no longer in the clone. Resync to refresh the list.
preview.reasonUnreadable: This document is listed in the clone but its contents could not be read. Check the file’s permissions and encoding in the repository.
preview.reasonNotCloned: This repository has no local clone, so its documents cannot be read.
preview.reasonUnknown: The file could not be read from the repository clone.
